text_en: Lan wanted to buy a present for her mum's birthday.
She had sixty thousand dong of pocket money.
She went to the shopping centre with her dad.
First, they looked at scarves, but they were too expensive.
Then Lan saw a beautiful striped bag in a sale.
The shop assistant said it was fifty thousand dong.
Lan paid in cash and got a receipt.
She spent most of her money, but she was happy.
Her mum loved the bag and wore it the next day.

questions.q: How much money did Lan have?
Why didn't Lan buy a scarf?
